title: Chocolate

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Chocolate
source.note: Đã rút gọn và đơn giản hoá nhẹ một số câu; thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Chocolate is a food made from cacao beans. It is used in many desserts like pudding, cakes, candy and ice cream. It can be solid, like a candy bar, or liquid, like hot chocolate. Most chocolate has sugar, and sometimes milk, added.

About two thousand years ago, Mayan people in Central America and Mexico used the seeds of the cacao tree to make a drink. It tasted bitter, not sweet, and only important people could drink it. The word “chocolate” in almost every language comes from the Nahuatl word chocolatl, from Mexico.

Later, the drink was made sweeter. Spanish explorers made it popular when they brought it to Spain. When chocolate was sweetened and made into candy, it became a very popular treat in Europe. At first, only the rich could afford it. Now, many people can.

There are three main types of chocolate: white, milk and dark chocolate. White chocolate is the sweetest because it has more sweet ingredients in it. Dark chocolate is the least sweet and has the strongest chocolate flavour. Today, most cocoa is made in Africa, in countries like the Ivory Coast and Nigeria.
